interest: Covers a Japanese/Wang Ching-wei letter demanding expulsion of Chungking agents from Hong Kong, listing Kuomintang financial and intelligence figures.
overview: Despatch No. 695 (1940): Southard forwards an anonymous Japanese/Wang Ching-wei letter demanding expulsion of eighteen Chinese 'Chungking agents' from Hong Kong, naming figures like Madame Kung and T. V. Soong; local papers refused to print it.
